'''Hayakawa Shrine''' (速川神社) refers to several Shinto shrines.

* '''Hayakawa Shrine''' - A {{ill|Shikinaisha|ja|式内社|lt=Shikinaisha}} located in {{ill|Etchū Province|ja|Etchū Province}}, {{ill|Imizu District, Toyama|en|Imizu District, Toyama|qid=Q6004195|lt=Imizu District}}.
''' '''{{ill|Hayakawa Shrine (Himi)|ja|速川神社 (氷見市)}}''' - A proposed site of the above. Located in Himi City, Toyama Prefecture.
''' '''{{ill|Hayakawa Shrine (Takaoka)|ja|速川神社 (高岡市)}}''' - Another proposed site of the above. Located in Takaoka City, Toyama Prefecture.
''' '''{{ill|Hayakawa Hachiman Shrine|ja|早川八幡社}}''' - Another related shrine. Located in Takaoka City, Toyama Prefecture.
* '''{{ill|Hayakawa Shrine (Saito)|ja|速川神社 (西都市)|qid=Q11639672}}''' - Located in Saito City, Miyazaki Prefecture.
